rateLimits.note: Client-credentials token requests (auth.uber.com/oauth/v2/token): 100 an hour, the 101st answered 429, and past 100 tokens a new one invalidates the oldest. The Api keeps its token (30 days) and asks for one only when it dies, inside whatever call needs it: refresh() is the only operation that asks on purpose.

provenance.notes: Contract-only: the Marketplace APIs' scopes need Uber's written approval ("Access to These APIs May Require Written Approval From Uber"; the partner manager). The Uber Eats API Terms of Use (last updated 2021-01-29) let Uber limit the number or nature of calls at any time and forbid circumventing a limit without its written approval; no figure is published for the order, store and menu endpoints (the platform-wide 500 requests per 5 seconds of developer.uber.com/docs/rate-limiting is not the Eats APIs' and is not declared). Uber Data and cached content are deleted when the access ends; non-public user content is not shared with third parties without the user's consent (redistribution forbidden); Uber's marks only with its written permission. No idempotency key on the order endpoints (accept_pos_order, deny_pos_order, cancel...): Omnifood sends each once, never retried.
